name: Onose Shizuka
source: Maid of the Wakamiya household who was told to spy on the protagonist. Is an ideal maid when comes to perfecting house hold chores but is a terrible student often ranked dead last. Will sometimes lie trying to be the perfect maid, but shows obvious reaction when she wants something.
